env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# A workspace root `logos build ./...` builds every Go module and every
# loGo/s module: a compile error in the loGo/s module fails the build
# even though the Go module is clean, and the clean module still builds
# on its own.
cd ws
! logos build ./...
stderr 'example\.com/wslgomod'
stderr 'main\.lgo'
logos build ./gomod
cd ..

# The Go-module half of the same sentence: a compile error in the Go
# module fails the same workspace build and names the Go module's file,
# and the same workspace root builds every module once the error is
# gone.
cd gows
! logos build ./...
stderr 'example\.com/gowsgomod'
stderr 'badgo\.go'
rm gomod/badgo.go
logos build ./...
cd ..

-- ws/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./gomod
	./lgomod
)

-- ws/gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/wsgomod

go 1.27

-- ws/gomod/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("go-ok")
}

-- ws/lgomod/go.mod --
module example.com/wslgomod

go 1.27

-- ws/lgomod/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println(undefinedSymbol)
}

-- gows/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./gomod
	./lgomod
)

-- gows/gomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gowsgomod

go 1.27

-- gows/gomod/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("go-ok")
}

-- gows/gomod/badgo.go --
package main

func broken() int {
	return undefinedGoSymbol
}

-- gows/lgomod/go.mod --
module example.com/gowslgomod

go 1.27

-- gows/lgomod/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	fmt.Println("lgo-ok")
}
